input.module_under_test: User Service: Basic CRUD operations for platform users. Supports creating users with unique username and email validation, retrieving users by ID, listing users with optional role filter and pagination, updating user profile fields (partial update with exclude_unset), and soft-deleting users. Three roles: creator, brand, admin. Duplicate username and email are checked at service level with ConflictError (409). Soft-deleted users are excluded from all queries. The service is the simplest module, serving as a baseline for test generation quality.
input.existing_test_patterns: Tests use pytest-asyncio with an httpx AsyncClient hitting the FastAPI app. No helper payload function — JSON is inlined in each test. Fixtures from conftest (sample_creator, sample_brand) provide pre-existing users. Assertions check HTTP status codes, JSON body fields, and error message substrings. Pagination is verified by checking total, page, total_pages fields. Soft delete is verified by deleting then confirming GET returns 404.

edge_cases_covered: Create user success with all fields verified (username, email, role, follower_count, id, created_at)
Duplicate username returns 409 with 'already exists' message
Get user by ID returns correct data including follower_count
Get non-existent user returns 404 with 'not found' message
List users with no data returns empty items and total=0
List users with data returns correct total and item count
List users filtered by role returns only matching role
Pagination: page_size=1 returns 1 item with correct total_pages
Update user partial fields preserves unchanged fields
Delete user returns 204 and subsequent GET returns 404

required_edge_cases: Get non-existent user returns not found
Soft delete: deleted user no longer retrievable
